name: Inflection AI
summary: Inflection AI is a public benefit corporation in Palo Alto. Mustafa Suleyman, Karén Simonyan and Reid Hoffman founded it in 2022, and it made the [Pi chatbot](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20230629810313/en/Inflection-AI-Announces-%241.3-Billion-of-Funding-Led-by-Current-Investors-Microsoft-and-NVIDIA).

incidents.title: Inflection AI Did Not Publish Its Promised Seoul Safety Framework
incidents.summary: Inflection AI signed the 2024 Frontier AI Safety Commitments, which asked each signatory to publish a safety framework before the February 2025 AI summit in France. According to SaferAI, Inflection had not published one.
incidents.description: Inflection AI agreed to the Frontier AI Safety Commitments at the AI Seoul Summit. The commitments asked each signatory to [publish a safety framework for severe risks](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024) by the February 2025 AI summit in France. According to [SaferAI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01166), Inflection is one of six signatories that have not published a framework.

timeline.title: Inflection signs the Seoul commitments
timeline.description: Inflection AI is among the 16 companies that agree to publish a safety framework before the next AI summit.

timeline.title: Deadline at the AI Action Summit in Paris
timeline.description: The commitments ask signatories to publish their frameworks by the AI summit in France.

timeline.title: SaferAI lists Inflection as not published
timeline.description: A SaferAI study of frontier safety frameworks says six signatories, including Inflection AI, have not published their frameworks.
